title: Strong Nouns — Neuter a-Stems
subtitle: Scip, word — identical nominative and accusative.
objectives: Understand and apply the concepts of Strong Nouns — Neuter a-Stems.
Read and parse examples from authentic Old English texts.

sections.heading: Core concept
sections.body: Neuter a-stems decline like masculine a-stems except: (1) nominative and accusative are always identical, and (2) the nominative/accusative plural ends in -u or is unchanged (depending on the weight of the root syllable).

sections.heading: Example
sections.body: Scip (ship): þæt scip (the ship, nom/acc), þæs scipes (gen), þǣm scipe (dat). Plural: þā scipu.

items.answer: Review the paradigm and example above.
